aggregation: Median of three per-round medians. Paired ratios divide before by after within each round; ratio of aggregated medians is reported separately.
timing_interpretation: CPU view/recording, CPU submission, GPU queries and full-frame readback are distinct intervals. Do not sum CPU and GPU or infer pipelined FPS. Retained process/GPU memory includes caches. Clocks are observed without power-setting changes; shared desktop applications remain running.
